children: The crypto market is showing signs of weakness, with its total value falling to $2.67 trillion, down 0.6% in 24 hours and 27.42% over the past year. The Crypto Fear & Greed Index is also at 31, showing that many investors are in FEAR.
However, falling prices have created buying opportunities, making these five altcoins worth watching like INJ, SUI, NIGHT, PENGU, and PROMPT.
5 Altcoins Showing Potential Buying Opportunities
1. Injective
First, Injective
is expanding into real-world finance. On October 20, 2026, it partnered with South Korean institution BDACS to bring KRW1, a won-backed stablecoin, to its network.
It also launched onchain options linked to real-world indices and commodities on October 27. Its October 29 Community BuyBack event included an INJ burn, though the amount has not been disclosed.
On the chart, INJ is showing a cup-and-handle pattern, with $6 as an important support level. If buyers defend it, the price could move toward $18.
2. Sui
Next, Sui

is expanding into AI-powered payments. Its October 8, 2026, Samsung Wallet partnership aims to bring USDC on Sui to 82 million Galaxy devices in the U.S. A live test also processed 40.6 million transactions per second through off-chain tunnels that settle on Sui. The network is also working with Alibaba Cloud on AI-agent payments.
SUI appears to be forming an inverse head-and-shoulders pattern. Support sits near $0.80, while the neckline is around $1.30. A breakout above it could open the way toward $2.
3. Midnight
Another project to watch is Midnight
, a privacy-focused network using zero-knowledge technology for private transactions and smart contracts.

On October 20, it introduced Nightmode, which lets users trade, lend, and stake through private balances without exposing their identities or transaction histories. NIGHT also generates DUST, which is used to pay network fees.
NIGHT has formed a golden cross on the three-day chart. Traders are watching the 25-day exponential moving average for support, with $0.070 as a possible upside target.

4. Pudgy Penguins
Pudgy Penguins

offers exposure to a consumer brand with a reach beyond crypto. The project has reportedly sold more than two million toys through over 10,000 stores, including Walmart and Target. However, these sales do not directly impact demand for the token.

On the chart, PENGU is forming a higher low within a channel that has been developing since February. The upper boundary near $0.011 is the next level to watch. A breakout could open the way toward $0.016.
5. Wayfinder
Finally, Wayfinder
is an AI-focused protocol built around AI-agent applications and its marketplace. Its weekly chart is showing a possible reversal, with the TD Sequential indicator printing a 13 buy signal.
Traders are now watching for a black 9 signal for further confirmation. The previous black 9 was followed by a rally of nearly 50%, though past moves do not guarantee similar gains.
The 25-week exponential moving average near $0.028 is the next recovery level to watch.

title: Crypto Market Is on Sale: Top 5 Altcoins Showing Buying Opportunities
